title: CUET 2026 General Aptitude Test Mock Test 2
description: Memory-based CUET 2026 May 31 Shift 1 General Aptitude Test question paper with solutions.

questions.question: Which of the following organizations publishes the annual Human Development Report (HDR)?
The term 'Blue Economy' is most closely associated with:
options: Sustainable use of ocean resources for economic growth

questions.question: If 15% of a number is added to the number itself, the result becomes 460. The original number is:
The term 'Gross National Happiness (GNH)' is primarily associated with which country?
A sum of money amounts to 24,200 in 2 years and 26,620 in 3 years at simple interest. The principal amount is:
Which of the following reports is published annually by the World Economic Forum (WEF)?
The 'Right to Privacy' was declared a Fundamental Right under the Constitution of India by the Supreme Court in which landmark case?
options: Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala
Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India
Justice K.S. Puttaswamy v. Union of India
Minerva Mills v. Union of India

questions.question: A train leaves Station A at 8:00 AM and travels towards Station B at a speed of 60 km/h. Another train leaves Station B towards Station A at 9:00 AM at a speed of 90 km/h. The distance between the stations is 390 km. At what time will the two trains meet?
Which of the following Nobel Prize categories was not included in Alfred Nobel’s original will?

Read the statements carefully. Statement I: All researchers are analysts. Statement II: Some analysts are economists. Statement III: No economist is a lawyer. Which of the following conclusions definitely follows?
